description: Mandated bindings (standards §18.2, §18.3): standing policy, separate from .architecture-exceptions.json. Each entry has an owner, a policy reference and an annual review date; entries do not expire. npm run check:bindings resolves every org-mandated binding per deployment target in the installed dependency tree and the built server, and fails on any mismatch.
